title: Managed hook entry in ~/.claude/settings.json
description:
Shape of a SINGLE hook entry written by a managed installer (Onda: agent-team-setup.ts) into the user's Claude Code settings.json. The marker '_onda' is what makes install/update/uninstall safe on a file the installer does not own. Claude Code ignores unknown keys in a hook entry, so the marker is inert at runtime.

OWNERSHIP RULE (non-negotiable, see CONTRACT.md 'Installer'):
  - The installer reads, updates and removes ONLY entries carrying '_onda'.
  - Any entry without the marker is foreign and MUST NOT be modified, reordered or removed, ever.
  - Marker-less entries pointing at the same script are reported as state 'foreign' in the UI and left untouched: the user registered them by hand and that decision wins.

Why it matters here: this user's settings.json already carries 5 SessionStart hooks (graphiti-load, session-start-rag-index, agent-team-os-load, morning-check, brandart-calendar-load), 2 UserPromptSubmit, 1 SessionEnd, 1 Stop - none of them ours. Clobbering them is the single highest-impact failure mode of the whole feature.

SYMLINK RULE: ~/.claude-a/settings.json is a symlink to ~/.claude/settings.json on this machine. The installer MUST resolve candidates through realpath and deduplicate by resolved inode before writing, or it writes the same file twice and doubles every entry.

command.description: Absolute path, or $HOME-prefixed path, to the managed hook script. Uses $HOME (not ~) for consistency with the entries already present in this file. Never ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}: that form is for the plugin distribution, not the managed install.

timeout.description: Optional per-hook timeout in seconds. The event hook is fire-and-forget and should finish well under 1s; set this only as a backstop.

_onda.description: Ownership marker AND version stamp. Presence = 'this entry is managed, the installer may rewrite or delete it'. The version drives migration: on boot the installer rewrites entries whose version is older than the bundle's, leaving everything else alone.

installerState.description: Result reported per settings file. 'installed' = marker entries added; 'updated' = marker entries rewritten to a newer version; 'unchanged' = already current (the second run MUST report this - it is the idempotence test); 'foreign' = a marker-less entry for our script exists, nothing was touched; 'missing-source' = the bundle is absent (dev build without build:agent-team); 'error' = write failed, backup retained.

events.description: Hook events the managed install registers onda-agent-event.mjs on. One script, switching on hook_event_name.
